description: When the prompt asks for current or external facts, push research before answering and require citations. High-recall keyword gate, so it leads with a condition and self-cancels.

text: If answering needs current external facts (a version, a release, an API shape, a comparison): research first and cite the source.
Prefer official documentation and the repository itself over blog posts. If two sources disagree, say so rather than picking one silently.
If this is answerable from the code in front of you, ignore this guidance.
